title: Fluent Heart
script:
-- ==========================================
-- 1. RE-EXECUTION CLEANUP & STATE STORAGE
-- ==========================================
if _G.UniversalHubCleanup then
    pcall(_G.UniversalHubCleanup)
end

local connections = {}
local activeLoops = {true}

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

_G.OriginalLighting = _G.OriginalLighting or {
    Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
    Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
    GlobalShadows = true,
    FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
    FogStart = Lighting.FogStart,
}

_G.OriginalGravity = workspace.Gravity
_G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom = LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance
_G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight

Lighting.GlobalShadows = true

-- Spectate Tracer Cleanup Variables
local spectateBeam = nil
local spectateAtt0 = nil
local spectateAtt1 = nil

local function removeSpectateTracer()
    if spectateBeam then pcall(function() spectateBeam:Destroy() end) spectateBeam = nil end
    if spectateAtt0 then pcall(function() spectateAtt0:Destroy() end) spectateAtt0 = nil end
    if spectateAtt1 then pcall(function() spectateAtt1:Destroy() end) spectateAtt1 = nil end
end

-- Custom Highlight & Billboard Containers Cleanup
local customHighlightFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
customHighlightFolder.Name = "UniversalHub_CustomHighlights"
customHighlightFolder.Parent = workspace

local playerHighlights = {}
local npcHighlights = {}

local function clearAllCustomHighlights()
    if customHighlightFolder then
        customHighlightFolder:ClearAllChildren()
    end
    table.clear(playerHighlights)
    table.clear(npcHighlights)
end

_G.UniversalHubCleanup = function()
    activeLoops[1] = false
    
    for _, conn in ipairs(connections) do
        if conn and conn.Connected then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    table.clear(connections)

    removeSpectateTracer()
    clearAllCustomHighlights()
    if customHighlightFolder then customHighlightFolder:Destroy() end

    if workspace:FindFirstChild("UniversalFloatPlatform") then
        workspace.UniversalFloatPlatform:Destroy()
    end

    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if cam and LocalPlayer.Character then
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        elseif hrp then
            cam.CameraSubject = hrp
        end
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end

    if _G.OriginalLighting then
        Lighting.Brightness = _G.OriginalLighting.Brightness
        Lighting.Ambient = _G.OriginalLighting.Ambient
        Lighting.GlobalShadows = _G.OriginalLighting.GlobalShadows
        Lighting.FogEnd = _G.OriginalLighting.FogEnd
        Lighting.FogStart = _G.OriginalLighting.FogStart
    end

    workspace.Gravity = _G.OriginalGravity
    workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight
    LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom

    if _G.FluentWindow then
        pcall(function() _G.FluentWindow:Destroy() end)
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 2. EXECUTOR TIER & ENVIRONMENT DETECTION
-- ==========================================
local executorName = "Unknown"
local executorVersion = "Unknown"

pcall(function()
    if identifyexecutor then
        executorName, executorVersion = identifyexecutor()
    elseif getexecutorname then
        executorName = getexecutorname()
    end
end)

local lowerExecutorName = string.lower(executorName)
local isLowLevelExecutor = (
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "xeno") or 
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "delta") or 
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "hydrogen") or
    string.find(lowerExecutorName, "fluxus")
)

print("[FluentHeart]: Detected Executor -> " .. executorName .. " | Mode: " .. (isLowLevelExecutor and "Low-Level Compatibility Mode" or "Standard/Medium Mode"))

-- ==========================================
-- 3. SERVICES & CORE VARIABLES
-- ==========================================
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local StatsService = game:GetService("Stats")

local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()

-- Settings & Flags
local walkSpeedValue = 16
local jumpPowerValue = 50
local fovValue = 70

local customCameraZoomEnabled = false
local customCameraZoomValue = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom

local tpToolEnabled = false
local floatEnabled = false
local qeControlEnabled = true
local floatSpeedValue = 42
local floatBaseY = nil
local floatYOffset = -2

local potatoGraphicsEnabled = false
local fullbrightEnabled = false
local noFogEnabled = false

local customGravityEnabled = false
local customGravityValue = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity)
local disableSlidingEnabled = false
local instantAirControlEnabled = false

local joinLogEnabled = false
local playerJoinTimes = {}

local lowHpTrackerEnabled = false
local deathListenerEnabled = false
local deathLogs = {}
local lowHpDebounce = {}

local spectatingPlayer = nil
local selectedTpPlayer = nil
local spawnCFrame = nil

-- Sound Configuration System
local soundSettings = {
    LowHP = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://4590657391" },
    PlayerLeft = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9114220737" },
    General = { Volume = 0.5, SoundId = "rbxassetid://9060817403" }
}

local function playCustomSound(category)
    pcall(function()
        local cfg = soundSettings[category] or soundSettings.General
        local sound = Instance.new("Sound")
        sound.SoundId = cfg.SoundId
        sound.Volume = cfg.Volume
        sound.Parent = SoundService
        sound:Play()
        game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(sound, 3)
    end)
end

local function recordSpawnLocation(char)
    local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
    if hrp then
        task.wait(0.2)
        spawnCFrame = hrp.CFrame
    end
end

if LocalPlayer.Character then
    task.spawn(recordSpawnLocation, LocalPlayer.Character)
end
table.insert(connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(recordSpawnLocation))

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end

table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
    playerJoinTimes[player] = tick()
end))

local originalMaterials = {}
task.spawn(function()
    local parts = Workspace:GetDescendants()
    local yieldLimit = isLowLevelExecutor and 100 or 250
    for i = 1, #parts do
        local part = parts[i]
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
            originalMaterials[part] = part.Material
        end
        if i % yieldLimit == 0 then task.wait() end
    end
end)

table.insert(connections, Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(part)
    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
        originalMaterials[part] = part.Material
        if potatoGraphicsEnabled then
            part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        end
    end
end))

-- ==========================================
-- 4. HELPER FUNCTIONS & LOGIC
-- ==========================================

local function giveTeleportTool()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    
    local backpack = LocalPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not backpack then return end

    if backpack:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") or char:FindFirstChild("Teleport Tool") then return end

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = "Teleport Tool"
    tool.RequiresHandle = false

    tool.Activated:Connect(function()
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hrp and Mouse.Hit then
            local currentRotation = hrp.CFrame - hrp.CFrame.Position
            hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(Mouse.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) * currentRotation
        end
    end)

    tool.Parent = backpack
end

local floatPlatform = nil
local function updateFloatPlatform(dt)
    if not floatEnabled then
        if floatPlatform then
            floatPlatform:Destroy()
            floatPlatform = nil
        end
        floatBaseY = nil
        return
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hrp and hum then
        local hipOffset = (hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15) and (hum.HipHeight + 1.2) or 3.0
        local targetY = hrp.Position.Y - hipOffset

        if not floatBaseY then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        if math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 15 then
            floatBaseY = targetY
        end

        if hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            if targetY > floatBaseY and (targetY - floatBaseY) < 12 then
                floatBaseY = targetY
            end
        else
            if math.abs(targetY - floatBaseY) > 0.5 then
                floatBaseY = targetY
            end
        end

        local verticalSpeed = floatSpeedValue * dt
        if qeControlEnabled then
            if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY + verticalSpeed
            elseif UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) then
                hrp.CFrame = hrp.CFrame - Vector3.new(0, verticalSpeed, 0)
                floatBaseY = floatBaseY - verticalSpeed
            end
        end

        if not floatPlatform or not floatPlatform.Parent then
            floatPlatform = Instance.new("Part")
            floatPlatform.Name = "UniversalFloatPlatform"
            floatPlatform.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6)
            floatPlatform.Anchored = true
            floatPlatform.CanCollide = true
            floatPlatform.Transparency = 0.9
            floatPlatform.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
            floatPlatform.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
            floatPlatform.Parent = Workspace
        end
        
        local finalY = floatBaseY + floatYOffset
        floatPlatform.CFrame = CFrame.new(hrp.Position.X, finalY, hrp.Position.Z)
    end
end

local function isCharacterPart(part)
    local ancestor = part.Parent
    while ancestor and ancestor ~= Workspace do
        if ancestor:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
            return true
        end
        ancestor = ancestor.Parent
    end
    return false
end

local function stopSpectating()
    spectatingPlayer = nil
    removeSpectateTracer()

    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if cam and char then
        local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        
        if hum then
            cam.CameraSubject = hum
        elseif hrp then
            cam.CameraSubject = hrp
        end
        
        cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
    end
end

local function updateSpectateTracer()
    if not spectatingPlayer or not spectatingPlayer.Character or not LocalPlayer.Character then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local targetHRP = spectatingPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

    if not myHRP or not targetHRP then
        removeSpectateTracer()
        return
    end

    if not spectateBeam or not spectateBeam.Parent then
        spectateAtt0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        spectateAtt0.Name = "SpectateAtt0"
        spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP

        spectateAtt1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
        spectateAtt1.Name = "SpectateAtt1"
        spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP

        spectateBeam = Instance.new("Beam")
        spectateBeam.Name = "SpectateTracer"
        spectateBeam.Attachment0 = spectateAtt0
        spectateBeam.Attachment1 = spectateAtt1
        spectateBeam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
        spectateBeam.Width0 = 0.05
        spectateBeam.Width1 = 0.05
        spectateBeam.FaceCamera = true
        spectateBeam.LightEmission = 1
        spectateBeam.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0)
        spectateBeam.Parent = myHRP
    else
        if spectateAtt0 and spectateAtt0.Parent ~= myHRP then spectateAtt0.Parent = myHRP end
        if spectateAtt1 and spectateAtt1.Parent ~= targetHRP then spectateAtt1.Parent = targetHRP end
    end
end

-- ==========================================
-- 5. FLUENT & ADDONS INITIALIZATION
-- ==========================================
local successLoad, Fluent = false, nil

pcall(function()
    successLoad, Fluent = pcall(function()
        return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://github.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/releases/latest/download/main.lua"))()
    end)
end)

if not successLoad or not Fluent then
    pcall(function()
        successLoad, Fluent = pcall(function()
            return loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/master/main.lua"))()
        end)
    end)
end

if not successLoad or not Fluent then
    local httpRequest = (syn and syn.request) or request or http_request or (Fluxus and Fluxus.request)
    if httpRequest then
        pcall(function()
            local res = httpRequest({
                Url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/master/main.lua",
                Method = "GET"
            })
            if res and res.Body then
                successLoad, Fluent = pcall(loadstring(res.Body))
            end
        end)
    end
end

if not successLoad or not Fluent then
    warn("[FluentHeart]: Critical Error: Failed to load Fluent Library.")
    return
end

local SaveManager = nil
pcall(function()
    SaveManager = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dawid-scripts/Fluent/master/Addons/SaveManager.lua"))()
end)

local Window = Fluent:CreateWindow({
    Title = "Universal Client Hub (" .. (isLowLevelExecutor and "Lite/Xeno Mode" or "Full Mode") .. ")",
    SubTitle = "Fluent Edition",
    TabWidth = 160,
    Size = UDim2.fromOffset(600, 480),
    Acrylic = not isLowLevelExecutor,
    Theme = "Dark"
})

_G.FluentWindow = Window

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if not gameProcessed and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
        Window:Minimize()
    end
end))

local Tabs = {
    Player = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Local Player", Icon = "user" }),
    Players = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Players", Icon = "users" }),
    Visuals = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Visuals", Icon = "eye" }),
    Utilities = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Utilities & Tools", Icon = "wrench" }),
    Logs = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Server & Logs", Icon = "file-text" }),
    Config = Window:AddTab({ Title = "Config & Sound", Icon = "settings" }),
    Readme = Window:AddTab({ Title = "README", Icon = "book" })
}

-- ==========================================
-- 6. LOCAL PLAYER TAB
-- ==========================================

Tabs.Player:AddButton({
    Title = "Spawn TP",
    Description = "Teleports you back to where you spawned",
    Callback = function()
        local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if myHRP and spawnCFrame then
            myHRP.CFrame = spawnCFrame
            playCustomSound("General")
            Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Teleported", Content = "Teleported back to spawn location.", Duration = 2 })
        else
            playCustomSound("General")
            Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Spawn Error", Content = "Spawn location not recorded yet.", Duration = 2 })
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSection("Movement & Modifiers")

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("WalkSpeedSlider", {
    Title = "WalkSpeed",
    Default = 16,
    Min = 16,
    Max = 250,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        walkSpeedValue = Value
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then hum.WalkSpeed = Value end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("DisableSlidingToggle", {
    Title = "Disable Sliding",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        disableSlidingEnabled = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("JumpPowerSlider", {
    Title = "JumpPower",
    Default = 50,
    Min = 50,
    Max = 300,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        jumpPowerValue = Value
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.UseJumpPower = true
            hum.JumpPower = Value
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("GravityToggle", {
    Title = "Gravity",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        customGravityEnabled = Value
        workspace.Gravity = Value and customGravityValue or _G.OriginalGravity
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("GravitySlider", {
    Title = "Custom Gravity",
    Default = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity),
    Min = 0,
    Max = math.floor(_G.OriginalGravity * 3),
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        customGravityValue = Value
        if customGravityEnabled then
            workspace.Gravity = Value
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("MaxSlopeToggle", {
    Title = "Max Slope Angle (360°)",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        local hum = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if hum then
            hum.MaxSlopeAngle = Value and 360 or 45
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("InstantAirControlToggle", {
    Title = "Disable Air Sliding",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        instantAirControlEnabled = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("NoVoidToggle", {
    Title = "No Void",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        if Value then
            workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = -900000000000000000000000
        else
            workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = _G.OriginalFallenPartsDestroyHeight or -500
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("CameraZoomToggle", {
    Title = "Max Camera Distance",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        customCameraZoomEnabled = Value
        if Value then
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = customCameraZoomValue
        else
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = _G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("CameraMaxZoomSlider", {
    Title = "Camera Distance Max",
    Default = math.clamp(math.floor(_G.OriginalCameraMaxZoom), 0, 1280),
    Min = 0,
    Max = 1280,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        local stepValue = math.floor(Value / 10) * 10
        customCameraZoomValue = stepValue
        if customCameraZoomEnabled then
            LocalPlayer.CameraMaxZoomDistance = stepValue
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("FOVSlider", {
    Title = "Field of View",
    Default = 70,
    Min = 1,
    Max = 360,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        fovValue = Value
        Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("FloatToggle", {
    Title = "Float Platform",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        floatEnabled = Value
        floatBaseY = nil
        if not Value and floatPlatform then
            floatPlatform:Destroy()
            floatPlatform = nil
        end
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("FloatOffsetSlider", {
    Title = "Platform Y-Level",
    Default = 0,
    Min = -5,
    Max = 5,
    Rounding = 1,
    Callback = function(Value)
        floatYOffset = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("FloatQEToggle", {
    Title = "Enable Holdable Q / E Player Movement Controls",
    Default = true,
    Callback = function(Value)
        qeControlEnabled = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddSlider("FloatSpeedSlider", {
    Title = "Float Q/E Speed",
    Default = 42,
    Min = 10,
    Max = 200,
    Rounding = 0,
    Callback = function(Value)
        floatSpeedValue = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Player:AddToggle("TPToolToggle", {
    Title = "Give TP Tool",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        tpToolEnabled = Value
        if Value then giveTeleportTool() end
    end
})

-- ==========================================
-- 7. PLAYERS TAB
-- ==========================================

Tabs.Players:AddSection("Player Teleport & Spectate")

local spectateDropdown
local playerDropdown

playerDropdown = Tabs.Players:AddDropdown("PlayerTeleportDropdown", {
    Title = "Select Target Player to TP",
    Values = {"None"},
    Multi = false,
    Default = "None",
    Callback = function(Value)
        selectedTpPlayer = Value
        if Value and Value ~= "None" then
            local targetPlayer = Players:FindFirstChild(Value)
            if targetPlayer and targetPlayer.Character then
                local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if targetHRP and myHRP then
                    myHRP.CFrame = targetHRP.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 3)
                    playCustomSound("General")
                    Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Teleported", Content = "Teleported to " .. targetPlayer.Name, Duration = 3 })
                end
            else
                playCustomSound("General")
                Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Teleport Error", Content = "Player character not found.", Duration = 3 })
            end
        end
    end
})

spectateDropdown = Tabs.Players:AddDropdown("SpectatePlayerDropdown", {
    Title = "Select Player to Spectate",
    Values = {LocalPlayer.Name},
    Multi = false,
    Default = LocalPlayer.Name,
    Callback = function(Value)
        if Value == "None" or not Value or Value == LocalPlayer.Name then
            if spectatingPlayer ~= nil then
                stopSpectating()
                playCustomSound("General")
                Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Camera Reset", Content = "Camera returned to your player.", Duration = 3 })
            end
            return
        end

        local targetPlayer = Players:FindFirstChild(Value)
        if targetPlayer then
            spectatingPlayer = targetPlayer
            if targetPlayer.Character then
                local targetHum = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                local targetHRP = targetPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if Workspace.CurrentCamera then
                    if targetHum then
                        Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = targetHum
                    elseif targetHRP then
                        Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = targetHRP
                    end
                end
            end
            updateSpectateTracer()
            playCustomSound("General")
            Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Spectating", Content = "Now spectating " .. targetPlayer.Name, Duration = 3 })
        end
    end
})

local function refreshPlayerLists()
    local tpNames = {}
    local spectateNames = {LocalPlayer.Name}

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            table.insert(tpNames, p.Name)
            table.insert(spectateNames, p.Name)
        end
    end

    if #tpNames == 0 then
        playerDropdown:SetValues({"None"})
    else
        playerDropdown:SetValues(tpNames)
    end

    spectateDropdown:SetValues(spectateNames)
end

table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(refreshPlayerLists))
table.insert(connections, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    if spectatingPlayer == player then
        stopSpectating()
        if spectateDropdown and spectateDropdown.Value ~= LocalPlayer.Name then
            spectateDropdown:SetValue(LocalPlayer.Name)
        end
        playCustomSound("General")
        Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Spectate Stopped", Content = player.Name .. " left the server.", Duration = 4 })
    end
    refreshPlayerLists()
end))
refreshPlayerLists()

Tabs.Players:AddSection("Player Trackers & Death Logs")

Tabs.Players:AddToggle("LowHPTrackerToggle", {
    Title = "Track Low HP Players (<= 35 HP)",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        lowHpTrackerEnabled = Value
    end
})

Tabs.Players:AddToggle("DeathListenerToggle", {
    Title = "Listen for Player Deaths & Log Position",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
        deathListenerEnabled = Value
    end
})

local deathDropdown = Tabs.Players:AddDropdown("DeathLocationDropdown", {
    Title = "Select Logged Death Location",
    Values = {"None"},
    Multi = false,
    Default = "None",
})

Tabs.Players:AddButton({
    Title = "Teleport to Death Location",
    Callback = function()
        local selectedLabel = deathDropdown.Value
        for _, entry in ipairs(deathLogs) do
            if entry.label == selectedLabel then
                local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                if myHRP and entry.cframe then
                    myHRP.CFrame = entry.cframe + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
                    playCustomSound("General")
                    Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Teleported", Content = "Teleported to death location of " .. entry.name, Duration = 3 })
                end
                break
            end
        end
    end
})

local function bindCharacterTrackers(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end

    local function onCharacter(char)
        local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 5)
        if not hum or not hrp then return end

        table.insert(connections, hum.HealthChanged:Connect(function(health)
            if lowHpTrackerEnabled and health <= 35 and health > 0 then
                if not lowHpDebounce[player] then
                    lowHpDebounce[player] = true
                    playCustomSound("LowHP")
                    Fluent:Notify({
                        Title = "Low HP Alert",
                        Content = player.Name .. " is low! (" .. math.floor(health) .. " HP)",
                        Duration = 4
                    })
                end
            elseif health > 35 then
                lowHpDebounce[player] = nil
            end
        end))

        table.insert(connections, hum.Died:Connect(function()
            if deathListenerEnabled then
                local deathCF = hrp.CFrame
                local timeStr = os.date("%I:%M:%S %p")
                local label = string.format("%s Died [%s]", player.Name, timeStr)

                playCustomSound("General")
                Fluent:Notify({

Tabs.Visuals:AddButton({
    Title = "Highlight Evaluated Paths (Through Walls)",
    Description = "Evaluates paths within range and places wall-penetrating highlights",
    Callback = function()
        for _, hl in ipairs(activePathHighlights) do
            if hl then hl:Destroy() end
        end
        table.clear(activePathHighlights)

        local myHRP = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        local function evaluateAndHighlight(str)
            if not str or str == "" then return end
            pcall(function()
                local fn = loadstring("return " .. str)
                if fn then
                    local res = fn()
                    local targets = {}
                    if typeof(res) == "Instance" then
                        table.insert(targets, res)
                    elseif type(res) == "table" then
                        for _, item in pairs(res) do
                            if typeof(item) == "Instance" then
                                table.insert(targets, item)
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    for _, target in ipairs(targets) do
                        if target:IsA("BasePart") or target:IsA("Model") then
                            local partToCheck = target:IsA("Model") and target.PrimaryPart or target
                            if partToCheck and myHRP then
                                local dist = (partToCheck.Position - myHRP.Position).Magnitude
                                if dist <= pathRangeLimit then
                                    local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight")
                                    highlight.Adornee = target
                                    highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)
                                    highlight.OutlineColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
                                    highlight.FillTransparency = pathHighlightTransparency
                                    highlight.OutlineTransparency = pathHighlightTransparency
                                    highlight.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
                                    highlight.Parent = customHighlightFolder
                                    table.insert(activePathHighlights, highlight)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
        end

        evaluateAndHighlight(pathInputExpr)
        evaluateAndHighlight(pathInputProp)
        playCustomSound("General")
        Fluent:Notify({ Title = "Path Evaluated", Content = "Wall-penetrating highlights applied within range.", Duration = 3 })
    end
})

            local youngSecs = math.floor(now - playerJoinTimes[youngestPlayer])

            local oldSession = string.format("%dh %dm %ds", math.floor(oldSecs/3600), math.floor((oldSecs%3600)/60), oldSecs%60)
            local youngSession = string.format("%dh %dm %ds", math.floor(youngSecs/3600), math.floor((youngSecs%3600)/60), youngSecs%60)

            local oldAccountAge = oldestPlayer.AccountAge
            local youngAccountAge = youngestPlayer.AccountAge

            playCustomSound("General")
            Fluent:Notify({
                Title = "Server Session Info",
                Content = string.format(
                    "• Longest: %s (%s, %d days)\n• Newest: %s (%s, %d days)",
                    oldestPlayer.Name, oldSession, oldAccountAge,
                    youngestPlayer.Name, youngSession, youngAccountAge
                ),
                Duration = 8
            })
        end
    end
})

local function refreshConfigDeleteList()
    pcall(function()
        if listfiles and isfolder and isfolder("FluentHeartHub/Configs") then
            local files = listfiles("FluentHeartHub/Configs")
            local names = {}
            for _, file in ipairs(files) do
                local name = string.match(file, "[^/\\]+$")
                if name then table.insert(names, name) end
            end
            if #names > 0 then
                configDeleteDropdown:SetValues(names)
            else
                configDeleteDropdown:SetValues({"None"})
            end
        end
    end)
end

refreshConfigDeleteList()

table.insert(connections, LocalPlayer.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
    char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    task.wait(0.5)

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.WalkSpeed = walkSpeedValue
        hum.UseJumpPower = true
        hum.JumpPower = jumpPowerValue
    end

    if tpToolEnabled then giveTeleportTool() end
end))

table.insert(connections, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView ~= fovValue then
        Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView = fovValue
    end

    if fullbrightEnabled then
        Lighting.Ambient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
        Lighting.Brightness = 2
    end

    if spectatingPlayer then
        if spectatingPlayer.Character then
            local targetHum = spectatingPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local targetHRP = spectatingPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local targetSub = targetHum or targetHRP

            if targetSub and Workspace.CurrentCamera and Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject ~= targetSub then
                Workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraSubject = targetSub
            end
            updateSpectateTracer()
        else
            removeSpectateTracer()
        end
    else
        removeSpectateTracer()
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
    if floatEnabled then
        updateFloatPlatform(dt)
    end

    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

    if hrp and hum then
        if disableSlidingEnabled and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude == 0 then
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, 0)
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
        end

        if instantAirControlEnabled and hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall then
            if hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
                local targetVel = hum.MoveDirection * hum.WalkSpeed
                hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(targetVel.X, hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y, targetVel.Z)
            end
        end
    end
end))
